qualifier: gonad, genital tract, prostate and pancreatic endocrine lineage
name: Gonad, genital tract, prostate and pancreatic endocrine development
rationale: Members cover sex determination, gonad, uterus/vagina/oviduct, prostate, adrenal and pancreatic endocrine progenitor development; the gonadal, genital-tract and prostate content separates it from the pancreatic-duct, mammary and germ-cell confusables.

core: Cardiac muscle and fibroblast regulation in tissue repair
qualifier: cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibrotic matrix control
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation and fibroblast regulation in fibrotic repair
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation/differentiation and regeneration together with fibroblast migration, apoptosis, myofibroblast differentiation and ECM/collagen deposition in wound repair, unlike confusables centred on ECM disassembly, cardiac adaptation, TGF-beta/SMAD signaling or miRNA processing.

qualifier: inherited cytochrome P450 and transporter defects
name: Cholesterol synthesis and inherited P450 and transporter defects
rationale: Members are mevalonate/isoprenoid and cholesterol biosynthesis steps plus inherited defects mainly of CYP enzymes and lipid-related transporters; confusables instead hold bile acid synthesis, peroxisomal fatty acid or quinone metabolism.

qualifier: cobalamin, riboflavin, thiamine and biotin; inherited cobalamin defects
name: Cobalamin, riboflavin, thiamine and biotin transport and metabolism
rationale: All members concern uptake, transport and metabolism of cobalamin (including its inherited defects), riboflavin, thiamine and biotin, distinguishing it from folate/methionine, vitamin E/quinone and CoA/pyruvate confusables.

core: Male germ cell development and fertilization
qualifier: sperm acrosome, motility and zona pellucida binding
name: Male germ cell development, sperm function and fertilization
rationale: Members span germ cell migration/proliferation, Sertoli barrier, sperm structure (acrosome, manchette, mitochondrial sheath), capacitation, motility and sperm-egg binding/fusion, whereas confusables cover meiotic recombination, germline epigenetics or gonadal hormones.

core: Tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
name: PTK6 and ALK/LTK signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
rationale: Members are PTK6 signaling events, ALK/LTK signaling and tyrosine autophosphorylation driving PI3K-AKT and ERK activation, distinguishing it from MET and ERBB receptor confusables.

qualifier: FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3 and ALK-family fusions and mutants
name: Oncogenic FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3 and ALK-family kinase mutants
rationale: All members are cancer fusions, amplifications or mutants of FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3 and ALK/LTK kinases, unlike confusables built on EGFR/ERBB2 mutants, ALK drug-resistance or normal PI3K signaling.

name: Monocyte activation, aggregation and recruitment in inflammation
rationale: Members describe monocyte activation, aggregation, chemotaxis and extravasation with inflammatory cytokine/chemokine responses; confusables emphasise negative regulation of chemotaxis, monocyte surface identity or anti-inflammatory control.

name: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal stress response and glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: Members cover CRH and ACTH signaling, corticosterone/cortisol secretion and behavioral stress and fear responses, distinguishing it from drinking, neuropeptide, social behavior and glucocorticoid-receptor confusables.

qualifier: PPARG and LXR transcriptional control of triglyceride metabolism
name: White adipogenesis and LXR/PPARG-driven triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members are white fat cell differentiation/proliferation and PPARG- and NR1H2/3-regulated triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, unlike brown/beige thermogenic and PPARA/PGC-1alpha confusables.

name: Glomerular development and filtration barrier function
rationale: Members concern glomerular epithelium, endothelium, mesangium, basement membrane, nephrin/podocytes and glomerular filtration, whereas confusables cover tubule and nephron development or brush border/polarity.

qualifier: MYC-driven pre-rRNA cleavage and Pol I elongation
name: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members are pre-rRNA endonucleolytic cleavage and processing, Pol I transcription elongation, ribosome assembly and MYC target sets, distinct from rRNA modification, Pol I initiation/termination and chromatin confusables.

name: Defensin and antimicrobial peptide defense at mucosal surfaces
rationale: Members cover defensins, antimicrobial peptide production, bacterial agglutination/cytolysis, mucosal innate immunity and microbial cell-wall polymer metabolism, while confusables emphasise antifungal, neutrophil killing and metal sequestration.

qualifier: growth hormone-IGF and leptin JAK-STAT signaling
name: Growth hormone-IGF axis and leptin signaling in body growth
rationale: Members are growth hormone receptor JAK-STAT signaling, IGF receptor signaling, leptin signaling and regulation of organism growth, distinct from feeding, prolactin, thyroid and somatostatin confusables.

name: Keratan sulfate synthesis, degradation and inherited defects
rationale: All members concern keratan sulfate biosynthesis, degradation and disorders of its enzymes, distinguishing it from other glycosaminoglycan and dystroglycan glycosylation confusables.

name: PTK6 (BRK) non-receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Every member is a PTK6 signaling event (expression, activation by ERBB2, effectors and downregulation), unlike the Hippo, ERBB, MET and ALK/PI3K confusables.

name: GPI anchor and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are GPI anchor synthesis and attachment and galactosylceramide/ganglioside glycosphingolipid synthesis, distinct from nucleotide-sugar transport, protein lipidation and glycolipid transport confusables.

name: AKT-regulated FOXO transcription and neuronal apoptosis
rationale: Members describe AKT/PI3K control of FOXO localization, acetylation and target transcription with neuronal death outputs, distinguishing it from NRF2, IGF response, heat shock and UPR confusables.

Neddylation, COP9 signalosome and cullin-ubiquitin members form only part of the theme; four BTM modules on mitochondrial housekeeping, polycomb chromatin, centrosomal mitosis and RB1/BCL2L1 share no common biological theme with them.

name: Neuropeptide control of sleep-wake, social and stress behaviors
rationale: Members are orexin/relaxin neuropeptide signaling with sleep-wake regulation, mating, parental, aggressive, drinking and stress behaviors, unlike confusables emphasising opioid/G-protein synaptic signaling or HPA corticosteroid responses.

name: C-type lectin receptor signaling in antifungal innate immunity
rationale: Members are Dectin-1, Dectin-2 family and DC-SIGN signaling, fungal recognition and IL-23 production, distinct from IL-17 and Th1/IFN-gamma confusables.

name: HGF-MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are HGF/MET receptor activation, recycling, inhibition and downstream effectors (with MST1/RON), distinct from integrin, ALK, PTK6 and TGF-beta receptor mutant confusables.

name: ABCA1-mediated lipid efflux and HDL/LDL particle remodeling
rationale: Members cover ABCA1/apoA-I phospholipid efflux, HDL assembly and HDL/LDL remodeling, whereas confusables centre on regulation of cholesterol efflux, LXR targets and foam cells.

name: Interferon-gamma signaling and Th1 cell differentiation
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma signaling and its regulation, IL-12 JAK-STAT, Th1 differentiation and cytokine production and MHC induction, distinguishing it from dendritic cell IL-12 production, antigen presentation and Th17/Treg confusables.

name: Calcineurin-NFAT and phosphatase regulation in muscle atrophy
rationale: Members regulate calcineurin-NFAT signaling and dephosphorylation together with muscle inactivity, atrophy and SCF proteolysis, unlike confusables on cell size, contraction, regeneration and cardiac adaptation.
